messages.content: 洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？

function.name: get_co-ordinate
function.description: Fetch geographical coordinates of a particular location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city name you want coordinates for.

message.content:
洛杉磯（太平洋時間）與柏林（中歐時間）的時差通常是 **9 小時**，柏林比洛杉磯早 9 小時。

> **注意：**  
> 由於兩地都實行夏令時間，但開始與結束日期略有不同，實際時差在某些月份會短至 8 小時或長至 10 小時。  
> - 3 月中旬至 3 月下旬（美國已進入夏令時間，歐洲尚未）：差 10 小時。  
> - 10 月下旬至 11 月初（歐洲已結束夏令時間，美國仍在夏令時間）：差 8 小時。  
> 其餘時間則為 9 小時。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？" (What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?). They want the time difference. We need to consider daylight saving changes. Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (PT), Berlin is Central European Time (CET). Usually difference is 9 hours (Berlin ahead). But during DST, Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin is CEST (UTC+2) difference still 9 hours. Actually check: Standard: Los Angeles UTC-8, Berlin UTC+1 difference 9 hours. During DST: Los Angeles UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2 difference 9 hours. So always 9 hours. But sometimes if one is on DST and other not? But both observe DST simultaneously? Actually DST start dates differ: US starts second Sunday in March, ends first Sunday in November. Europe starts last Sunday in March, ends last Sunday in October. So there is a period in March and October where difference might be 8 or 10? Let's compute: In early March before US DST starts but after Europe DST starts? Europe DST starts last Sunday in March (~31 March). US DST starts second Sunday in March (~14 March). So between 14 March and 31 March, US is still standard (UTC-8), Europe is DST (UTC+2). Difference 10 hours. After 31 March until 1 November, both DST: difference 9 hours. Then from 1 November to 14 November, US DST ends (back to UTC-8), Europe still DST (UTC+2) until last Sunday in October (~31 Oct). Wait timeline: US DST ends first Sunday in November (~7 Nov). Europe DST ends last Sunday in October (~31 Oct). So between 31 Oct and 7 Nov, Europe DST ended (UTC+1), US still DST (UTC-7). Difference 8 hours. After 7 Nov, both standard: difference 9 hours.

Thus difference varies: 8,9,10 hours depending on date. The question likely expects general answer: 9 hours difference. But we can mention variations. Provide answer in Chinese. No function call needed.
